{{Quote|Thank goodness someone has finally come to rescue Maliiki. I think my leg is broken, the pain is unbearable.|A wounded Maliiki upon being found by a medical droid|<ref name="Star Wars: DroidWorks">''[[Star Wars: DroidWorks]]''</ref>}}
'''Maliiki''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]]. While he was attempting to rebuild an [[Unidentified rogue assassin droid|escaped droid]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], another [[Unidentified Imperial assassin droid|assassin droid]] cut the ropes holding a catwalk where he stood. As he fell, a crate tumbled over him, trapping the Jawa. Later, he was rescued by a [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]], who he rewarded by guiding him to the nearly-finished [[Droid/Legends|droid]] and the data [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] with important information that it possessed.
